Subject: Calloway Bistro Group - Quote Request

Hi Dana,

Thanks for the submission on Calloway Bistro Group! I've reviewed the materials and everything looks good to move forward.

I'll work up a quote for the December 23, 2026 effective date and should have something back to you within the next few days. The 2-location restaurant risk with $2.6M total insured value fits well within our appetite, and I appreciate having the complete application, SOV, and loss history upfront.

I'll be in touch soon with pricing. Let me know if anything changes in the meantime.

Best regards,

[Underwriter name]
